versions.changelog:
- Initial release of sol-seo-health: automated daily SEO audit for blog posts.
- Validates essential SEO elements (title, description, image, canonical URL, OG tags) on all posts.
- Checks for broken internal links, duplicate titles, and missing/invalid sitemap, robots.txt, and RSS feed.
- Runs automatically after each site build; logs detailed reports to `logs/sol-seo.log`.
